research.facts:
2028 Recruiting Contact Period Opens TODAY
**Sources:**
- NCAA recruiting calendar (confirmed Oct 17-18 as direct contact window for class of 2028 prospects)
- D1Softball / NFCA recruiting coverage
- Program recruiting announcements (OU, Tennessee, Florida, Texas)
**Key Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Oct 17-18 = first direct contact window for 2028 recruits; D1 coaches can call prospects directly for the first time
- Tennessee holds the No. 4 national class for 2028 (per national recruiting rankings); added Reagan Eldred
- OU has 5 commits in the 2028 class including pitcher Sophia Schlader
- Florida has Kylie Holden (No. 2 nationally, multi-infield/utility MI) and Evans committed
- Texas has the No. 1 nationally ranked 2028 prospect (Michaela Landers per Softball America)
- FSU landed twins Keira and Kelsey Luderer for the 2028 class
- Oklahoma State also building strong 2028 class foundation
**Freshness:** Contact window opens TODAY — maximally fresh.
